summary: Sandy pull-off on Meiers Road beside the river and golf course, no homes near.
reasons: Sandy pull-off clear of the lane

best_section.where: Sandy pull-in on the river side of Meiers Road, opposite the golf course, about 90 m before the car park entrance at 800 m

drivers.seclusion: Bush and the river on the north side, golf course across the road; nearest mapped building is a non-dwelling 15 m off at 930 m, no homes seen.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare sand and dirt surface meets the road edge and is wide enough for a van; a dirt track loop at about 900 m shows tyre marks.
drivers.traffic: Through road with some traffic; a car and a van parked on the road nearby.
drivers.convention: Vehicles parked around the road and verges here; no signs mapped.

flags: Low-lying: river 37 m away, about 9 m elevation near here but 4.6 m at 100 m
Substation compound and track just north of 900 m: keep clear of its gate
Locked gate 241 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Mix of open sand with tree shade from the east and north.
cannot_judge: Whether the sand patch is soft
